question_cn: 2026 世界杯小组赛 H 组：西班牙 vs 佛得角，90 分钟三路赛果？
question_en: 2026 FIFA World Cup Group H: Spain vs Cabo Verde — 90-minute three-way result?
one_liner_cn: Elo 世界第一的西班牙实力碾压首次参赛的佛得角，胜率约 82.5%；边锋伤情与热身两连平令平局风险略升至 14%。
one_liner_en: World-Elo-No.1 Spain overwhelmingly outclass debutants Cabo Verde at roughly 82.5% to win; winger fitness doubts and two warm-up draws lift draw risk slightly to 14%.

key_reasons.cn: Elo 差距 579 分（2157 vs 1578），戴维森三路模型给出西班牙约 86% 的统计胜率基线。
key_reasons.en: A 579-point Elo gap (2157 vs 1578) yields a roughly 86% statistical baseline win probability for Spain under the Davidson three-way model.

key_reasons.cn: Yamal、Nico Williams 缺席末场热身留营恢复，预计 6 月 15 日可用但可能限制时间；Fermín López 跖骨骨折伤缺整届。
key_reasons.en: Yamal and Nico Williams skipped the final warm-up to recover and may be on minute restrictions on June 15; Fermín López is out of the tournament with a metatarsal fracture.

key_reasons.cn: 佛得角史上首次参赛，26 人名单仅 1 名五大联赛球员，阵容厚度有限；西班牙热身平埃及、伊拉克后 3-1 胜秘鲁。
key_reasons.en: Debutants Cabo Verde have just one top-five-league player in their 26-man squad; Spain drew warm-ups vs Egypt and Iraq before beating Peru 3-1.

method_note: Market-blind: Davidson three-way Elo model (scale=400, drawNu=0.7, neutral venue, no host bonus) gives p_stat 85.6/11.3/3.1; bounded evidence adjustment of 3.1pp (cap ±8pp) for Spain winger fitness, Fermín absence and deep-block draw risk; renormalized to 82.5/14.0/3.5. No betting or prediction-market inputs.
